title: Náutico faces Botafogo-SP seeking stability in Série B
seoTitle: Náutico faces Botafogo-SP seeking stability in Série B
subtitle: Hélio dos Anjos' squad tries to transform unbeaten streak into a G-6 spot
excerpt: With seven games unbeaten, Náutico visits Botafogo-SP at Esportes da Sorte Aflitos. Coach Hélio dos Anjos highlights the search for stability and the.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Náutico enters the clash against Botafogo-SP with seven consecutive matches without defeat and the goal of consolidating stability in Série B. Coach Hélio dos Anjos emphasizes that the team needs to turn this good momentum into consistent results.

What coach Hélio dos Anjos highlights ahead of the duel

In a press conference at the Wilson Campos training center, Hélio dos Anjos stressed that the search for stability involves winning another home game and making the players perform better and better. He kept his feet on the ground, stating that there is no relief, even post-game, in the locker room, and that internal demands remain constant.

How the seven-game unbeaten streak influences the campaign

The Pernambuco club, with 34 points, occupies 12th place and is five points behind CRB, who rounds out the G-6. Another victory against Botafogo-SP could bring Náutico even closer to the qualification zone, boosting the confidence of both the team and the fans.

The importance of the return of Vinícius and Júnior Todinho

Hélio dos Anjos praised the return of forwards Vinícius and Júnior Todinho, highlighting that both played in different roles in the previous match and showed great intensity. The coach considered the team's tactical moment to be its best on the wings, especially due to the performance of these players.

Points outlook and G-6 position

With the match scheduled for Thursday at 8 p.m. at the Esportes da Sorte Aflitos stadium, a victory could lift Náutico up the table and bring them closer to the Série B G-6. The coach believes the team still has room to perform better on the pitch and grow throughout the competition.

With information from ge.
